body: I can't bear to watch this happen anymore. My fingers tremble as I reach for the exit sign on the wall, feeling its cold steel beneath my touch. As I pull open the door, I slam it shut behind me, leaving the museum in ruins and the eerie silence echoing through the halls. My heart pounds so loud that I swear I could hear it beating from the opposite side of the room.
